profile.headline: SDE at Audible, Inc.
profile.summary: Current Senior Undergraduate at Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Skilled in Java and Python. Have industry experience with data analysis, software engineering, and android devices.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Research a program to recognize English speech using human linguistic parameters
- Process speech signal and train models to match sound frequency to appropriate linguistic landmarks

company.name: Research Laboratory of Electronics at MIT

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Update visual and back-end compatibility for Audible application on the Fire TV
- Develop new user interactive experience on the app

positions.title: Data Scientist Intern
positions.description:
- Used real data and unsupervised machine learning techniquse to analyze survey responses
- Improved the algorithm to search for documents related to a specific theme inside a survey corpus
- Developed feature extractors and trained the features to select high quality contents in a corpus

positions.title: Project Member
positions.description:
- Interview teachers and students to assess important issues in the current educational system
- Cooperate with team to brainstorm and develop a mobile application that improves instant feedback between students and teachers while providing concise data for future lesson plans
- Present to and advocate potential partnership with teachers and educators

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Used Wordpress to proofread, edit and creatively organize written posts and photos in order to
engage interest in the library Teen Council's website
- Recognized and hired by the librarian in charge of Teen Council to transfer contents from her old
website to her new one for one summer between sophomore and junior high school year
